# The stripped-signature test preserves body text but current icon policy differs

1967 adds a multipart/signed fixture without a signature MIME part and a test that waits for OpenPGP processing before checking body text and icons. The original expected a signed mismatch icon; accepted test now expects no signed icon and no encryption icon. A selected later D276028 test delta confirms that expectation change as context only. Keep missing-signature result handling separate from current icon display policy and test the text remains body content. No later full bug/review or complete commit coverage is claimed. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: OpenPGP stripped-signature tests.
